in <ab>comp.</ab> or with <ab>instr.</ab>; श्वासः प्रमाणाधिकः <ls>Ś. 1. 29</ls> more than the usual measure. .³({%b%}) Inordinate, grown, increased, become greater; abounding in, full of; strong in; ˚क्रोध <ls>R. 12. 90</ls>; रसाधिके मनसि <ls>Śi. 17. 48</ls> abounding in. .²3 .³({%a%}) More, greater, stronger, mightier, more violent or intense; अधिकां कुरु देवि गुरुभक्तिम् <ls>K. 62</ls>; ऊनं न सत्त्वेष्वधिको बबाधे <ls>R. 2. 14</ls> the stronger animal did not prey on the weaker;
